_meta.description: The repository's own paper competition: every username in data/competition/roster.json trades a frozen contrarian or baseline strategy on captured vendor daily bars with a fresh 250,000 virtual USD account per edition, under the official rule constants. NOT the official contest, NOT a TradingView Strategy Report, NOT a prediction.
_meta.price_source: data/market_history_index.json (market_data_vendor tier; front-month continuous, unadjusted rolls)

edition_design.final_window_note: LATEST is the 30-calendar-day window ending at the last captured session; it may overlap the final season edition and is excluded from season standings.

moderate.label: commission $1.50/contract/side + slippage 5% of ATR(14) per leg

high.label: commission $2.50/contract/side + slippage 10% of ATR(14) per leg

assumptions: Daily bars only; the official contest allows intraday trading, so this simulation understates achievable trade frequency (hypothesis H27).
Signals evaluate on a bar's close and fill at that series' next bar open; slippage is a declared fraction of the decision bar's ATR(14) on both legs; commission per contract per side.
Notional accounting uses entry prices marked at each symbol's most recent processed open; no intra-bar margin calls are simulated (breaches are counted, not acted on).
Season multiple is the product of edition multiples with each edition floored at 0 (a real margin account cannot lose more than its balance); negative-multiple editions are counted separately.
Vendor series are front-month continuous futures with unadjusted roll splices; roll gaps can create artificial gap-fade signals.
Every edition gives every participant a fresh 250,000 account; season standings sum realized P/L across editions.

Universe limitation: the live September 2026 edition admits 0 equities, so this competition runs on volatile futures captures; a highly volatile STOCKS division requires new committed stock OHLC captures (the sandbox has no direct market-data egress; the capture workflow runs on GitHub Actions) and is queued for the next session.

models.name: Capitulation reversal
models.claim: A multi-day collapse (or euphoria run) that stretches price by >=1 ATR over 3 closes with ATR expanding is over-extended and mean-reverts over the next ~10 sessions.

models.name: Gap fade
models.claim: An opening gap larger than 1.5 ATR(14) is over-reaction, not information: fading the gap direction captures the close-the-gap drift over ~5 sessions.

models.name: Band-pierce reversion
models.claim: A close outside the 2-sigma band that re-enters the 1-sigma zone the next session marks the impulse as exhausted; price reverts toward the basis.

models.name: Exhaustion-bar reversal
models.claim: A range-expansion exhaustion bar (true range >= 2x ATR with the close pinned in the extreme quartile of the bar) marks liquidation climax; the next sessions revert.

models.name: Capitulation pyramider
models.claim: Contrarian capitulation entries followed by full-reinvestment pyramiding every 1 ATR of favourable drift concentrate capital into the rare explosive reversals the placement arithmetic requires.

models.name: Donchian breakout (baseline)
models.claim: Baseline trend-following Donchian breakout (for contrast against the contrarian roster).

models.name: EMA impulse (baseline)
models.claim: Baseline EMA-crossover impulse continuation (for contrast against the contrarian roster).

models.name: Squeeze release (baseline)
models.claim: Baseline Bollinger squeeze release (for contrast against the contrarian roster).

target_summary.basis: participant-editions at moderate cost across 24 season editions
